info.title: GATEWAY-apiwizdoc-List Streaming Subscriptions Trials-v5-spec
info.description: The Streaming Subscription Trials API allows developers to access and list current trial subscriptions for streaming services. This API is vital for businesses looking to manage or display trial subscriptions effectively. Typical consumers include application developers and marketing teams who need real-time insights into subscription usage. By leveraging this endpoint, users can optimize their offerings and improve customer engagement. It supports operational efficiency in subscription management, ensuring users stay informed about trial opportunities.

get.description: This endpoint allows you to fetch details about trial subscriptions available in the system. It provides comprehensive information related to the subscription features, validity, and any other relevant data users may find useful.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to retrieve information about trial subscriptions. It should contain the necessary parameters to specify the request context, and it expects a JSON format.
